title: a11y Commands Reference
desc: Reference and history: deprecated commands, verified tests, USAGE-REMOVED patterns, audit notes.
steps: Deprecated: win-click (2026-05-02). 'wkappbot --sudo win-click hwnd:0xABCD x y' now prints '[WIN-CLICK:SUGGEST] a11y click "<grap>#<node>"' + '[WIN-CLICK:DEPRECATED]' and exits with error 1. Migrate to: a11y click <grap> --x N --y N. MDI child windows are emitted in the suggested grap as {proc:app}#{mdi-child-title}#Node[aid=X]. The deprecation suggest is paste-ready; rerun the command using a11y click.

USAGE-REMOVED evidence pattern: do NOT call wkappbot a11y eval directly in evidence scripts -- it auto-files a new BUG-AUTO suggest each time. Instead verify deprecation via: (1) wkappbot file grep 'USAGE-REMOVED.*eval' --type cs -- shows the guard in source code. (2) check existing BUG-AUTO logs. (3) wkappbot skill read a11y-command-cheatsheet
grep eval-js -- confirms migration path is documented. This avoids cascading BUG-AUTO noise from test harness.
--eval-js without #node: shows node list (read falls through), then returns error. evalJsBlockedNoNode flag pattern: set in foreach before read, check after foreach to print error + return 1.

[AUDIT 2026-05-29] A11yGridRead moved out of A11yActions.Read.cs (file no longer contains literal token). Other refs (A11yCommand.cs, AskCommands.Focus.cs) still resolve. Update on next re-contribute.
